question: Does joint selection of contact force and motion across all four horizontal slip sectors produce an independently verified finite body-progress step at the original recovery entry?

population.selection: Only original R10AP partial step1 / semantic step513. No perturbed, propagated, held-out or new native inputs.
population.coverage: R10AX admits no step under prescribed opposing dominant sectors. Jointly search all six modes of every original contact without prespecifying torso or limb sliding direction; independently verify the chosen finite proposal before propagation or controller selection.

algorithm.mode_encoding: For each of seven original contacts choose exactly one:0 inactive,1 sticking,2 +worldX slide,3 -worldX slide,4 +worldZ slide,5 -worldZ slide. Inactive contributes zero normal force and hence zero force under the cone; active normal velocity is zero. Sticking also has zero tangent velocity. Sliding satisfies its signed dominant-velocity sector and matching maximum-dissipation friction-diamond vertex.
algorithm.force_and_motion: Solve14-coordinate bounded incremental kinematics and14-coordinate generalized gravity/actuator/contact balance together. Retain published impulse/dt caps,mu1.8 inner diamond,positive normal forces, all-marker non-descent,24 shape-floor witnesses and0.02-rad nonworsening joint headroom. Each normal force<=total weight follows from vertical static balance; tangent components<=mu*weight. No force at an invented contact.
algorithm.scaling: Normalize14 increments by existing coordinate bounds, contact forces by measured weight and torques by published caps. Force balance rows normalize by max(1,abs(gravity row)). Conditional row bounds derive exactly from finite variable boxes plus1e-12 rounding allowance, never an arbitrary unbounded big-M.
algorithm.search: SciPy1.16 milp / HiGHS, one binary choice per mode,42 binary and43 continuous variables; maximize original-heading torso progress normalized by0.1*dt.60-second /100000-node limits,relative optimality gap0,presolve enabled. Solver failure or limit is retained without admission.
algorithm.verification: Check recomputed scaled primal residual and integrality<=1e-6. Rebuild the chosen continuous mode without binary conditional bounds; certify its maximal progress independently with the R10AR LP primal/dual checker. Match reported search objective within1e-6 normalized units. Then preserve optimum within1.2e-7 normalized units and minimize normalized absolute coordinate motion.
algorithm.finite_check: If physical forward increment>1e-9 m, test11 dyadic scales and four nonzero fractional nodes. Project sticking xyz and sliding normal positions to original positions with at most10 Newton corrections. Keep floor, marker non-descent, coordinate/joint and signed-sector residuals<=1e-9; require finite body progress>1e-9*fraction. Re-solve force balance for that mode at each node and check maximum-dissipation displacement work within1e-9 J. Zero tangent motion on a sliding boundary is allowed and conveys no dynamic-transition authority.
algorithm.claim_limit: A positive verified result is one model step only. Search bounds are solver-reported, not an independently reconstructed proof of global optimality. A refusal cannot establish physical impossibility. No mode retries, altered bounds or objective changes after exposure.

checks: 53 manufactured controls including all inherited36, nine integer/four-sector force checks and eight conditional-bound truth-table checks. Shared baseline checks are not additive new controls.
Original entry contact replay and all source/runtime dependency bindings.
Independent fixed-mode continuous optimization certificate and strict nonlinear/force checks after any successful mixed-integer proposal.
Fresh-process full deterministic reproduction; incomplete or non-reproduced search remains unqualified.

research_sources.use: Pinned installed solver integrality, bounds, constraints, finite limits, status and reported MIP gap semantics.
Coulomb friction, maximum dissipation, polyhedral friction and the distinction between contact models and actual dynamics.

limitations: Frozen-entry quasistatic and sampled geometry model only; excludes inertia, changing collision points, rolling/contact acquisition, native motor response, continuous swept collisions and physical acceptance. Original moving-entry, penetration and sampling/callback caveats persist. Authored friction is not native-calibrated.
